# Feature: Lantern — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #52 (Lantern) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: widens your light for one room. Unique: a light buff scoped to a single room. Useful: a choice of which dark room deserves the help. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** widens your light for one room.

**So that** a choice of which dark room deserves the help.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Lantern for the first time in its teaching room (mech-52-lantern-room). Teaching moment: First room: a dark room with the lantern near its entrance and a one-way exit halfway through. A player who picks up the lantern and leaves by the one-way exit before searching the room loses the widened light with the orb still inside, which teaches that the lantern belongs to the room it is found in and that the room is finished before it is left. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Picking it up widens your radius from two tiles to four for that room only
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Leaving the room ends it
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It is not consumed by time
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Its fuel partner is lantern oil

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Picking it up widens your radius from two tiles to four for that room only
- It is not consumed by time
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Lantern's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-52-lantern-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #52.
